blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Among visual localization strategies, scene coordinate regression (SCR) has emerged as an attractive approach for its compactness, accuracy, and speed. Despite these advantages, SCR models generalize poorly across substantially different camera models, such as omnidirectional or strongly rectified imagery. This limitation arises because, changes in field of view, lens distortion, or rectification-induced resampling can make the same scene content appear differently depending on its pixel position, degrading localization accuracy. To cope with this limitation, we introduce Ray-SCR, a lightweight extension to existing SCR architectures that conditions local visual features on their calibrated viewing rays and refines neighboring ray-conditioned features with a shallow local Transformer. We further formulate supervision directly in ray space and use sparse SfM points as metric anchors that link observations across views and camera models. Taken together, these components enable a single scene representation built from a panoramic mapping sequence to accurately localize query images captured with very different cameras, including pinhole, fisheye, and omnidirectional cameras.
  We evaluate Ray-SCR across multiple SCR architectures and on datasets with pinhole, fisheye, and omnidirectional cameras. The proposed ray conditioning substantially improves generalization across cameras and leads to state-of-the-art localization performance in these challenging cross-camera settings. The project page is available at https://jaeminch0.github.io/ray-scr-generalizing-scene-coordinate-regression-across-camera-models/.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Visual localization techniques allow to estimate the pose of a query image within a known scene. This process is central to many applications in robotics [ 30 ] , mapping [ 35 ] , and augmented reality [ 32 ] . Scene coordinate regression (SCR) [ 5 , 4 ] approaches this task by learning, for each scene, a mapping from local image descriptors to 3D scene coordinates. Recently, SCR techniques have become particularly attractive for their fast training and inference, compact scene representation, and high localization accuracy.
blocks.zh: 视觉本地化技术可以估计已知场景内查询图像的姿势. 这个过程对于机器人学[30],映射[35],以及增强现实[32]的许多应用都是至关重要的. 场景坐标回归 (SCR) [5, 4] 接近此任务,方法是为每个场景学习从局部图像描述符到3D场景坐标的映射. 最近,SCR技术对于他们的快速培训和推论,紧凑的场景表现,以及高的本地化精度都变得特别有吸引力.

blocks.en: Despite these advantages, existing SCR solutions have been designed primarily for perspective cameras, or rectified images, and do not explicitly account for the strong distortions and non-uniform image resolution induced by omnidirectional imaging systems. As a result, the same local scene structure can produce substantially different image features depending on the camera geometry, which limits the ability of SCR models to generalize across heterogeneous cameras.

blocks.en: To mitigate that limitation, one can train SCR with images rendered from different camera configurations, exposing the network to a wider range of distortions. However, SCR relies on local image features, while the distortion affecting each patch depends on its position in the camera field of view. Therefore, without access to the corresponding viewing direction, the network has no explicit information about where a local feature lies within the camera projection. As shown in Table 5 , such augmentation significantly improves cross-camera localization, but remains insufficient on its own.
blocks.zh: 为了减轻这种限制,人们可以用不同相机配置所制造的图像来训练SCR,使网络暴露出更广泛的扭曲. 然而,SCR依赖于本地图像特性,而影响每个补丁的扭曲则取决于其在相机视域中的位置. 因此,在无法访问相应取景方向的情况下,网络没有关于相机投影中局部特征位置的明确信息. 如表5所示,这种增强可大大地改善跨相机本地化,但单靠自身仍然是不够的。

blocks.en:
Building on this observation, we propose Ray-SCR, which augments each local visual feature with its corresponding calibrated camera ray, providing the network with the viewing direction associated with that observation. A shallow local transformer further refines neighboring features to capture projection-dependent local patterns. Beyond feature conditioning, we formulate the training objective directly in ray space, using the angular distance between predicted and observed viewing directions. Unlike image-plane reprojection, this measure is independent of the camera projection model and can therefore be applied consistently across pinhole, fisheye, and omnidirectional cameras.
In addition, we exploit sparse SfM points as metric 3D anchors, linking observations across views and camera models to a common scene coordinate.
blocks.zh:
基于这一观察,我们提议雷-SCR,它用相应的校正相机射线来增强每个局部的视觉特征,为网络提供与该观察相关的取景方向. 一个浅的局部变压器会进一步完善相邻的特性来捕捉依赖投影的局部形态. 除了特征条件外,我们利用预测和观测到的取景方向之间的角距离,在射线空间直接制定训练目标。 与影像-平面再投影不同的是,这一措施独立于相机投影模型,因此可以一致地跨越针孔,鱼眼和全向相机.
此外,我们利用稀少的SfM点作为度量的3D锚地,将各种观点和相机模型的观测与共同的场景坐标联系起来.

blocks.en: We validate Ray-SCR primarily on 360Loc [ 14 ] , where scenes mapped from panoramic sequences are queried using five different camera configurations under both day and night conditions. Across several SCR backbones, Ray-SCR consistently improves cross-camera localization and outperforms existing cross-device methods, including CDG-Loc [ 40 ] . We further evaluate the approach on OmniScenes [ 18 ] , where it surpasses scan-based localization methods [ 21 ] while retaining a compact scene representation, and on Aachen [ 33 ] to assess its behavior in a large-scale perspective setting with heterogeneous camera intrinsics.
blocks.zh: 我们主要在360Loc[14]上验证Ray-SCR, 在白天和夜间条件下, 在几个SCR主干线上,雷-SCR不断改进跨相机本地化,并超越了现有的交叉分解方法,包括CDG-Loc [40]. 我们进一步评价OmniScenes [18] 的方法,它超越了基于扫描的本地化方法[21],同时保留了紧凑的场景表现方式;评价Aachen [33] 的方法,以具有多相相机内在的大规模视角评估其行为。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are: • We introduce Ray-SCR, which conditions local visual features on calibrated camera rays and jointly refines neighboring features to improve scene coordinate regression across heterogeneous cameras. • We formulate SCR supervision directly in ray space and complement it with sparse SfM anchors, providing metric 3D supervision while promoting consistent scene-coordinate predictions across views and camera models. • We demonstrate the generality of Ray-SCR across several SCR architectures and three benchmarks, achieving state-of-the-art localization on 360Loc and OmniScenes, while substantially improving the corresponding SCR baseline on Aachen.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献是: 我们引入了Ray-SCR,它为校准相机射线的局部视觉特征提供了条件,并共同改进相机的相机特性,以改善不同相机的场景坐标回归。 我们直接在射线空间制定SCR监督,并以稀疏的SfM锚地作为补充,提供度量3D监督,同时促进对各种观点和相机模型的一致的场景坐标预测。 我们展示了雷-SCR在几个SCR架构和三个基准上的通俗性,实现了360Loc和OmniScenes最先进的本地化,同时大大改进了相应的SCR在Aachen的基线.

blocks.en: In this section, we review scene coordinate regression and omnidirectional and cross-device localization.

blocks.en: 2.1 Scene Coordinate Regression
blocks.zh: 2.1 场地坐标回归

blocks.en:
Visual localization estimates the camera pose of a query image with respect to a pre-built map. A common approach is structure-based localization, which typically follows a hierarchical pipeline: it first retrieves database images depicting similar parts of the scene, then establishes local feature matches between the query and retrieved images to obtain 2D–3D correspondences with an SfM map, from which the camera pose is recovered geometrically [ 34 , 31 ] .
Recently, FastForward [ 1 ] represents posed mapping images as a collection of features anchored in 3D space and localizes a query in a single feed-forward pass.
blocks.zh:
可视化本地化估计出一个查询图像相对于预建地图的相机外观. 一个常见的方法是基于结构的本地化,通常遵循分级管道:它首先检索描绘相近场景部分的数据库图像,然后在查询和被检索的图像之间建立本地特征匹配,以获得与SfM地图相通的2D–3D通信,从中相机平面被恢复几何[34,31].
最近,FastForward [1] 代表将映射图像作为定位于3D空间的特征集,并将一个查询定位在一个单一的向导通道中.

blocks.en:
An alternative is to encode the scene implicitly in network weights, avoiding an explicit geometric map. For instance, absolute pose regression follows this paradigm by training a scene-specific network on images with known camera poses and directly regressing the pose of a new query from its learned representation [ 17 , 36 ] . While such methods offer a compact and efficient localization pipeline, they lack the geometric grounding of correspondence-based estimation, leading to poor accuracy [ 34 ] .
Camera Ray Regression [ 41 ] instead predicts world-coordinate rays from image patches and recovers camera pose geometrically.
blocks.zh:
另一种方法是将场景隐含地编码入网络权重中,避免显式几何地图. 例如,绝对反向反应遵循这一范式,对有已知相机的图像进行场景特有网络培训,并直接使新查询的姿势从所学到的表述中倒退[17、36]。 虽然这些方法提供了紧凑而高效的本地化管道,但它们缺乏基于通信的估算的几何定位,导致准确性差[34].
相机雷回光 [41] 取而代之的是从图像补丁中预测出世界坐标射线,并恢复相机呈几何形状.

blocks.en:
SCR bridges these two paradigms by encoding the scene in a network. Because this avoids storing an explicit scene representation at inference time, SCR has often been regarded as comparatively privacy-preserving, although recent work has challenged this assumption [ 26 ] .
Rather than predicting the camera pose directly, the network predicts, for each pixel, the corresponding 3D scene coordinate, thereby producing dense 2D–3D correspondences from which the camera pose is recovered with a robust PnP algorithm.
The seminal SCR approach of Shotton et al. [ 38 ] learns to predict dense scene coordinates from RGB-D training data, providing 2D–3D correspondences that can be used for geometric pose estimation. To remove the reliance on ground-truth depth, DSAC* [ 6 ] proposes to use a CNN to learn scene coordinates directly from posed RGB images. More recently, ACE [ 4 ] then substantially accelerates this scene-specific training by combining a shared visual encoder with a lightweight coordinate regressor. Building on this pipeline, GLACE [ 39 ] incorporates an image-level global encoding to improve scalability to larger scenes, while ACE-G [ 7 ] introduces compact scene-specific map codes to reduce the mapping-to-query domain gap. FocusTune [ 27 ] further improves training by adapting the sampling of observations, while R-SCoRe [ 16 ] targets robustness at larger scale and under challenging illumination.
Despite these advances, existing SCR methods do not condition scene-coordinate prediction on the camera model. Camera geometry is only introduced afterward, through the reprojection objective and pose solver. Ray-SCR instead conditions the regressor directly on calibrated per-pixel viewing rays and uses the same ray representation for scoring and pose estimation, removing the assumption of a fixed perspective image plane.
Unlike predicting coordinate rays [ 41 ] and pose-dependent mapping rays [ 1 ] , Ray-SCR uses camera-coordinate rays to condition scene-coordinate prediction.
This makes a substantial difference in cross-camera settings, where the same scene may be observed through perspective, fisheye, or omnidirectional projections with very different pixel-to-ray mappings.
blocks.zh:
SCR通过将场景编码在一个网络中来连接这两个范式. 由于这避免了在推论时间存储明确的场景表现,所以SCR经常被认为是相对的隐私保护,尽管最近的工作挑战了这个假设[26].
网络不直接预测相机所摆出的位置,而是预测每个像素对应的3D场景坐标,从而产生密密的2D–3D通信,相机所摆出的位置用坚固的PnP算法来取回.
Shotton等人的开创性SCR方法。 [38] 学习从RGB-D训练数据中预测密集场景坐标,提供可用于几何平面平面估计的2D-3D通信. 为了消除对地-真实深度的依赖,DSAC* [6] 提议使用有线电视新闻网直接从所展示的RGB图像中学习场景坐标. 最近,ACE [4] 然后通过将共享的视觉编码器与轻量级坐标后退器相结合,大大地加速了这种场景特有训练. 在这个管道的基础上,GLACE [39] 包含了图像级的全球编码,以提高可扩展性到更大的场景,而ACE-G [7] 则引入了紧凑的场景特有地图编码来缩小映射到平地域间的差距. FocusTune [27] 进一步改进了培训,调整了观测的取样,而R-SCore [16] 的目标是在更大的规模和在具有挑战性的照明下坚固度。
尽管取得了这些进步,但现有的SCR方法并不将场景坐标预测作为相机模型的条件. 相机几何学只在后期被引入,通过再投影目标并摆出解相. 雷 -雷 -雷 -雷 SCR相反,直接将回转器附加在被校准的每像素取景射线上,并使用同一种射线表示来打分并作出估计,去除固定视角图像平面的假设.
与预测坐标射线[41]和姿势依赖的绘图射线[1]不同,雷- SCR使用相机坐标射线作为场景坐标预测的条件.
这在跨相机的设置上有很大的区别,在同一场景中,可以通过透视,鱼眼来观测,或者用非常不同的像素到射线的映射来进行全向预测.

blocks.en: 2.2 Omnidirectional and Cross-Device Localization
blocks.zh: 2.2 面向和交叉设备本地化

blocks.en: While hierarchical localization [ 31 ] is particularly effective on perspective imagery, its extension to cross-camera settings is not straightforward, as it requires retrieval strategies [ 37 ] and keypoint descriptors [ 9 , 11 ] invariant to changes in projection model and field of view.
blocks.zh: 虽然分级本地化[31]在视角图像上特别有效,但其延伸至跨相机设置并不直截了当,因为它需要检索策略[37]和关键点描述符[9,11]与投影模型和视野的变化不一致.

blocks.en: These limitations have led to omnidirectional localization methods that simplify the problem through stronger scene priors. PICCOLO and CPO localize panoramas directly in coloured point clouds through pose sampling and colour consistency [ 18 , 20 ] , while LDL and FGPL further reduce the search space using dominant line directions and intersections [ 19 , 21 ] . A complementary line of work replaces the 3D map with stronger indoor priors. For instance, LaLaLoc and LASER localize against floorplans [ 13 , 25 ] , while SPVLoc uses a coarse semantic 3D model [ 10 ] . While effective indoors, these approaches rely on strong assumptions about scene structure or map availability, limiting their applicability to more general environments. Moreover, they apply mostly to panoramic images and are often not suitable for fisheye or perspective cameras.
blocks.zh: 这些局限性导致了全向本地化方法,通过更强大的场景前传来简化了问题. PICCOLO和CPO通过姿势采样和颜色一致性[18, 20],将全景全景直接放入有色点云中,而LDL和FGPL则进一步用主线方向和相交点来缩小搜索空间[19, 21]. 互补的一行用更坚固的室内前身来取而代之的3D地图. 例如,LaLaLoc和LASER对照平面图[13,25]本地化,而SPVLoc则使用粗细的语义3D模型[10]. 这些方法虽然在室内有效,但依赖于对场景结构或地图可用性的强烈假设,限制了其对更一般环境的适用性. 此外,它们主要适用于全景图像,往往不适合鱼眼或视角相机。

blocks.en:
Cross-device localization, where the map is built with one device and queried with another, has so far been driven mainly by benchmarks. For instance, LaMAR [ 32 ] evaluates localization across phone and HoloLens 2 captures, while CroCoDL [ 3 ] extends this setting to a legged robot. In both cases, however, the images remain perspective, and the domain gap mainly arises from changes in viewpoint, motion, and sensing platform. 360Loc [ 14 ] instead explicitly studies changes in camera projection, mapping from 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} images and querying with pinhole, fisheye, and 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} cameras. Existing solutions typically handle such cross-device variations through input transformation or additional training data: 360Loc renders virtual perspective views to reuse conventional localization pipelines, SPR [ 42 ] learns scene-agnostic relative pose, and CDG-Loc [ 40 ] reconstructs scenes with 3DGS to synthesize additional training views. These approaches improve robustness to device changes, but do not provide a representation inherently shared across camera models. Ray-SCR instead uses viewing rays as a common geometric representation across projections.
Note that such invariance could also be obtained on the feature side, through spherical convolutions or distortion-aware descriptors. Doing so, however, means abandoning the strong pretrained encoders, for which no fisheye or 360 counterpart exists.
blocks.zh:
交叉设备本地化,即地图用一个设备构建,并用另一个设备询问,到目前为止主要是由基准驱动的. 例如,LaMAR[32]通过电话和HoloLens 2捕获来评价本地化,而CroCoDL[3]将这种设置扩展到了有腿的机器人. 然而,在这两种情况下,图像仍然是透视的,域位差距主要出自观点、运动和感知平台的变化。 360Loc [14] 转而明确研究相机投影的变化,从360QQ360XCirc}相机的映射以及用针孔,鱼眼,和360X360XCirc}相机的查询. 现有解决方案一般通过输入转换或额外培训数据处理此类交叉设备变异:360Loc使虚拟视角视角再用常规本地化管道,SPR[42]学习场景-不可知相对姿势,CDG-Loc[40]用3DGS重建场景以合成额外的培训视角. 这些方法提高了设备改变的稳健性,但不能提供在相机模型中固有的共享的表示. 雷 -雷 -雷 -雷 SCR取而代之的是将射线作为各种预测的共同几何表示.
需要注意的是,在地物侧面也可以通过球状回转或被扭曲-认知的描述来得到这种偏移. 然而,这样做意味着放弃强大的事先训练过的编码器,因为对于这些编码器,没有鱼眼或360对等设备。

SfM points are projected into each view, and features whose angular distance θ i \theta_{i} from the corresponding viewing ray 𝐫 i \mathbf{r}_{i} is below a predefined threshold are retained in the training buffer. blocks.en:
While effective for perspective cameras, none of SCR formulations account for the viewing geometry, treating local features identically regardless of their viewing direction. This becomes a problem for fisheye and panoramic images, where the appearance and sampling of a neighborhood depend strongly on its viewing direction. Note that undistortion, as shown in Table 6 ,
does not fully resolve this problem, as it introduces spatially varying resampling and stretching near the image boundaries.
Ray-SCR addresses this by associating each feature with its calibrated viewing ray ( 3.1 ). The ray modulates the feature, and a lightweight local transformer then adapts each neighborhood into a representation shared across perspective, fisheye, and panoramic cameras (Sec. 3.3 ). We further use sparse SfM points, already available from scene reconstruction, as direct 3D anchors (Sec. 3.4 ). Since a point is observed from several viewpoints and camera models, these anchors push different observations of the same structure toward a consistent 3D coordinate.

blocks.en: Each image location is first mapped through the given camera model to a unit bearing vector on the viewing sphere. This bearing is paired with the 3D coordinate predicted by the SCR model, forming a set of bearing–3D correspondences. We estimate the camera pose using a bearing-vector P3P solver within RANSAC, as implemented in OpenGV [ 15 ] , and then refine the resulting pose with robust nonlinear least squares by minimizing the angular error between the observed bearing vectors and the directions of the predicted 3D points under the estimated pose.
blocks.zh: 每个图像位置首先通过给定相机模型被映射到一个在取景球上带有向量的单位. 这种轴承与SCR模型所预测的3D坐标对接,形成一组轴承-3D对应. 我们使用在 OpenGV [15] 中实施的 RANSAC 内部的轴向器 P3P 解析器来估计相机的外观,然后通过将所观测到的轴向量与估计外观下预测的3D点方向之间的角差最小化,以坚固的非线性最小平方来细化所形成的相机外观.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Datasets. We evaluate Ray-SCR on three complementary benchmarks covering different scales, camera configurations, and localization settings. 360Loc [ 14 ] , our primary benchmark, covers campus-scale indoor and outdoor environments with symmetric structures, repetitive appearance, and dynamic pedestrians. Each scene is mapped from a posed 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} sequence and queried using pinhole, fisheye, and 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} cameras under day and night conditions. We further evaluate on OmniScenes [ 18 ] , a room-scale indoor benchmark with panoramas captured from handheld and mobile robot-mounted cameras before and after scene rearrangement; we use its joint-space setting to evaluate localization between handheld and robot-mounted captures under scene rearrangement. Aachen [ 33 ] complements these experiments with a city-scale outdoor setting, where mapping and query images exhibit varied camera intrinsics and fields of view.
blocks.zh: 数据集. 我们评价雷-SCR的三个互补基准,涵盖不同的尺度、相机配置和本地化设置。 360Loc [14],我们的首要基准,涵盖校园规模的室内外环境,具有对称结构,重复外观,动态行人. 使用针孔、鱼眼、360相机, 我们进一步在OmniScens [18] 上评价,这是一个室内室标基准,在场景重排前后从手持和移动机器人上架相机中捕获全景;我们利用其联合空间设定来评价场景重排下手持和机器人上架相机上架相机的捕获之间的本地化. Aachen[33]用一个城市规模的户外环境来补充这些实验,其中绘图和查询图像显示各种相机内在和视野。

blocks.en:
Implementation Details. We implement Ray-SCR in PyTorch and optimize its trainable components with mixed-precision AdamW. On 360Loc, mapping images are resized to a maximum long edge of 1024 pixels, and each scene is trained for 70,000 iterations on NVIDIA RTX A5000 GPUs. For Ray-ACEG, we use a training buffer size of 9M and learning rates of 1 ​ e − 4 1\mathrm{e}{-4} for the Ray Adapter and 3 ​ e − 4 3\mathrm{e}{-4} for the scene-specific map code. The ray reprojection and SfM anchor losses use equal unit weights; the latter uses Smooth- L 1 L_{1} with β = 0.25 \beta=0.25 and at most 4096 SfM observations per mapping image.
The Ray adapter uses 10 Fourier frequencies and a low-rank width of 64, followed by a single-layer, 4-head local Transformer with 256-dimensional tokens operating on 8 × 8 8{\times}8 windows. The final projections of the FiLM, additive ray embedding, and Transformer residual branches are zero-initialized, so that the adapter initially preserves the pretrained features.
Settings for the other SCR backbones, OmniScenes, and Aachen are provided in the supplementary material.

执行细节。 我们在PyTorch执行Ray-SCR,并优化其可训练组件与混合精度亚当W. 在360Loc上,映射图像被调整为最大长边缘为1024像素,每个场景在NVIDIA RTX A5000GPU上接受7万次迭代训练. 对于Ray-ACEG,我们使用9M的训练缓冲器大小和1 e - 4 1\mathrm{e}{-4}的学习速率,用于Ray适配器和3 e - 4 3\mathrm{e}{-4}用于场景特有地图代码. 射线再投影和SfM锚丢失使用等单位重量;后者使用平滑-L 1 L_{1}并有β=0.25\β=0.25,最多每张映射图像的SfM观测.
Ray适配器使用10个傅里叶频率和64个低等宽度,后为单层,4个头的局部变形器,有256维的活字符,运行于8×8 8×times}8个窗口. FiLM,添加剂射线嵌入,和变形器残余分支的最终预测都是零初始化的,因此适配器最初保留了被预先训练的特征.
其他SCR骨干,OmniScens,和Aachen的设置在补充材料中提供.

blocks.en: 4.2 Cross-Camera Localization
blocks.zh: 4.2 跨卡梅拉本地化

blocks.en: On 360Loc, we compare Ray-ACEG with the absolute pose regression baselines PoseNet (PN) [ 17 ] and MS-Transformer (MS-T) [ 36 ] , their virtual-camera variants PN-VC2 and MS-T-VC2 [ 14 ] , and the cross-device localization method CDG-Loc [ 40 ] . We use the baseline results reported by CDG-Loc under the same evaluation protocol. For each scene and query camera, we report the median translation and rotation errors.
blocks.zh: 在360Loc上,我们比较了雷-ACEG与绝对平面还原基线PoseNet(PN)[17]和MS-Transformer(MS-T)[36],他们的虚拟相机变体PN-VC2和MS-T-VC2[14],以及交叉设备本地化方法CDG-Loc[40]. 我们使用CDG-Loc在同一评价协议下报告的基线结果。 对于每个场景和查询相机,我们报告中位数的翻译和旋转错误.

blocks.en: Day and night localization. For the main comparison, we instantiate Ray-SCR with ACE-G, using a single scene model to localize all five query cameras. Following CDG-Loc [ 40 ] , each scene map additionally includes 10–20 nighttime frames. Tables 1 and 2 show that Ray-ACEG achieves the lowest rotation error for every camera type and scene under both illumination conditions, as well as the lowest scene-average translation error in six of eight settings. Compared with the previous best method, CDG-Loc, Ray-ACEG reduces the average rotation error by more than 2 × 2\times across the eight scene–illumination settings. The largest gains are observed for narrow-FoV pinhole queries, with the advantage retained at night.
blocks.zh: 昼夜地化. 为了进行主要比较,我们用ACE-G对Ray-SCR进行即时处理,使用单一的场景模型将所有五个查询相机本地化. 继CDG-Loc [40]后,每个场景地图还额外包括了10–20个夜间时间帧. 表1和表2显示,Ray-ACEG在两种发光条件下实现每个相机类型和场景的最低自转误差,以及8个设置中6个最小的场景-平均翻译误差. 相较于之前的最佳方法CDG-Loc,Ray-ACEG将平均自转出错减少2×2\次以上,跨越了8个场景-光照设置. 观测到的最大收益是窄-FoV针孔查询,其优势在夜间保留.

blocks.en: Compatibility across SCR architectures. We generalize Ray-SCR across SCR backbones by applying the same ray conditioning, training objective, and pose estimation to DSAC* [ 6 ] , ACE [ 4 ] , and GLACE [ 39 ] (Table 3 ). Unlike ACE-G, these backbones encode each scene in a scene-specific prediction head, with DSAC* additionally learning its encoder per scene. Despite this architectural difference, all three Ray-SCR variants localize the five camera types and outperform the original baselines in most 360Loc Day settings. Among them, Ray-GLACE provides the strongest results, indicating that the benefits of Ray-SCR are not tied to the ACE-G architecture.
blocks.zh: 跨SCR架构的兼容性. 我们通过应用同样的射线调节、训练目标,将雷-SCR贯穿于SCR主干线,并对DSAC* [6]、ACE [4]和GLACE [39](表3)作出估计。 与ACE-G不同的是,这些骨干将每个场景编码在一个场景特定的预测头上,DSAC*额外学习每个场景的编码器. 尽管有这种建筑差异,所有三种雷-SCR变体都将五相相机类型本地化,并在大多数360Loc Day的设置中都超过了原始基线. 其中,雷-GLACE提供了最强的结果,表明雷-SCR的好处与ACE-G架构无关.

blocks.en: 4.3 Omnidirectional and Perspective Localization
blocks.zh: 4.3 方向和视角本地化

blocks.en: OmniScenes. We compare against LDL [ 19 ] and FGPL [ 21 ] , and retrieval-and-matching pipelines combining CosPlace (CP) [ 2 ] or SFRS [ 12 ] with LightGlue (LG) [ 23 ] , GlueStick (GS) [ 28 ] , or GoMatch (GM) [ 43 ] ; all use explicit 3D maps. Since OmniScenes provides no mapping split, we instead learn an implicit neural map for each space from posed “unchanged” panoramas and localize “changed” queries through predicted 2D–3D correspondences on the joint seven-space Extreme split, where all seven spaces form a single localization problem.
blocks.zh: 央视网. 我们比较LDL[19]和FGPL[21],以及将CosPlace(CP)[2]或SFRS[12]与LightGlue(LG)[23]、GlueStick(GS)[28]或GoMatch(GM)[43]相组合的取回和匹配管道;所有这些管道都使用明确的3D地图。 自兹 OmniScens没有提供映射分割,相反,我们从“未改变的”全景中为每个空间学习一个隐含的神经图,并通过预言的2D-3D通信将“已改变的”查询本地化,这些通信涉及7个空间,所有7个空间都构成了一个单一的本地化问题。

blocks.en:
To deal with this multi-space setting, we follow ACE’s Poker strategy [ 4 ] : Ray-Poker-ACE estimates poses with all seven per-space regressors, selects the hypothesis with the strongest geometric support, and refines it. The same procedure is used for GLACE, DSAC*, and ACE-G.
Unlike LDL and FGPL, which process perspective crops rendered from the panorama, all four Ray-Poker-SCR variants directly consume each 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} query without cubemap conversion. Across the seven spaces, the four Ray-Poker-SCR variants achieve competitive recall accuracy. Among them, Ray-Poker-ACE improves recall by 3.9 % 3.9\% over FGPL while using 77 × 77\times less scene-specific storage (Fig. 5 ).

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented Ray-SCR, which uses calibrated camera rays to make scene coordinate regression explicitly aware of camera geometry. Our method conditions and locally refines visual features using their viewing rays and formulates scene-coordinate learning directly in ray space. Sparse SfM anchors further provide metric 3D supervision while linking observations across views and camera models to consistent scene coordinates. Across several SCR architectures, Ray-SCR substantially improves cross-camera localization, achieving state-of-the-art results on 360Loc and OmniScenes while also improving the corresponding SCR baseline on Aachen. These results establish calibrated ray conditioning as a practical way to extend compact SCR localization beyond perspective cameras.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了雷-SCR, 它使用校准相机射线 使场景坐标回归 明确意识到相机几何。 我们的方法条件和当地利用他们的取景光来完善视觉特征,并直接在射线空间中形成场景坐标学习. Sparse SfM主锚进一步提供公制3D监督,同时将跨视图和相机模型的观测与一致的场景坐标相接. 在整个几个SCR架构中,雷-SCR大幅度地改进了跨相机本地化,在360Loc和OmniScenes上取得了最先进的成果,同时也改善了相应的SCR在Aachen上的基线. 这些结果确立了校正射线调节,作为将紧凑的SCR本地化扩展出视野相机以外的实用方法.

blocks.en: Ray-ACE and Ray-GLACE [ 39 ] use ACE’s [ 4 ] frozen pretrained encoder and prediction head, an MLP of 1 × 1 1{\times}1 convolutions with residual blocks. Ray-DSAC ∗ [ 6 ] instead trains its encoder end-to-end per scene and uses a head of three 1 × 1 1{\times}1 convolutions with ReLU activations. blocks.en: Ray-SCR requires calibrated cameras. Since ray field is computed from the intrinsic calibration, calibration errors bias the mapping and camera pose estimation. Furthermore, the ray-conditioning modules add an inference overhead of 1 1 ms per image for Ray-ACE and 7 7 ms for Ray-ACEG.
